gigs.story: Our first Emergenza round. Backstage Club was packed, and thanks to everyone who came out for us, we made it through to the next round.

photos.alt: The band on the Backstage Club stage in blue light, phones up in the crowd
Singer and guitarist at the microphone, lit in blue
Wide shot of the stage: the whole band playing under yellow and blue lights
Hands in the air in front of the stage
Playing under the Emergenza banner

gigs.story: SPH Music Masters at Quax. We gave it everything we had and played to a lot of new faces.

photos.alt: Black and white: the whole band on the Quax stage, drummer on the left
Black and white: singing into the microphone, beams of light behind
Black and white: guitarist with long hair, backlit by a spotlight
Black and white: guitarist shot from below, light cutting through the haze
Black and white: the drummer behind the kit, grinning, one hand up

gigs.story: Nonnenwaldrock was a fundraiser: local bands playing to raise money for the venue itself. Places like this keep the scene alive, and we were glad to give something back.

photos.alt: Black and white: the drummer mid-song
Black and white: singing with eyes closed
Guitarist and bassist side by side in red light
Black and white: the bassist in a beam of stage light
Black and white: guitarist with long hair, lit from behind

gigs.story: We won our Emergenza semifinal at Strom. That night sent us to the Bavarian final, and it's still one of the biggest moments we've had as a band.

photos.alt: The band on the Strom stage in haze and white light
On stage in red light, next to the host with a microphone
Black and white: three of us playing at the front of the stage
Black and white: singer and bassist, one foot up on the monitor
Both guitarists playing in the haze under spotlights

gigs.story: The Emergenza final for Bavaria, as one of the top ten bands in the state. We had a blast on that stage and went home with good feedback and a lot of motivation to keep going.

photos.alt: The singer in silhouette under a single spotlight, haze everywhere
Black and white: guitarist crouched low on the stage
The band playing in red and orange light
Red stage, white light beams fanning out behind a guitarist
A full Backstage Halle seen from the back, the band on a blue-lit stage

gigs.story: So many people. One of our biggest shows so far, on the 3M Stage at Augsburger Sommernächte, and it clicked from the very start.

photos.alt: A band selfie on top of the Augsburger Sommernächte festival poster
The crowd in the street at night, arms in the air
The outdoor stage at night, the band playing between old town houses

gigs.story: A spontaneous one: we played the Glockenbachwerkstatt in the Glockenbachviertel together with our friends The Racoons. Very DIY, an unforgettable Tuesday.

photos.alt: Black and white: the drummer behind the kit, half in shadow, a blur of light on the wall behind
Black and white: the singer laughing into the microphone, guitar in hand, a white bass at the edge of the stage
Two shots of guitar and bass side by side: one in black and white, one in red and purple light

gigs.story: A benefit concert at the Tiefstollenhalle for the children's hospice being built in Polling, with The Mains, Metamorphine and Archonaut.

photos.alt: A flash photo outside at night: two people hugging by a wooden bench, a sunflower and beer bottles on the bench

gigs.story: Zamanand is Bavarian for “together”, and for a weekend in September Ludwigstraße became one long free street festival, from Odeonsplatz up to the Siegestor. We played the Odeonsplatz stage after dark, right in the middle of the city.

photos.alt: Black and white: singing at the microphone, guitar in hand, the drummer and a guitarist behind
Black and white: the whole band on the Zamanand stage, the drummer in the middle, the festival banner behind
Black and white: bassist and guitarist bent low over their instruments at the front of the stage
Black and white: the bassist in a white shirt, head down, under the stage lights

gigs.story: Sprungbrett, Feierwerk's contest for Munich musicians: we played the Kranhalle together with Moskau78, PoWasser and Hospital Meat.

photos.alt: Singer and guitarist in silhouette at the microphone, haze and a bright spotlight behind
Guitarist kneeling at the front of the stage, grinning into the camera, the bassist bent over the bass behind, in blue light
The bassist in a white jacket under purple spotlights, the Sprungbrett banner behind
Guitarist bent low over the guitar, long hair lit up yellow by a spotlight
